title: Output schema of the Japan Fuel Price MCP server
description: MCP server (Standby mode): tool responses are returned over the MCP streamable-HTTP protocol as structuredContent (region, product, unit JPY/liter or JPY/18L, price, survey_date, week_over_week). This schema exposes the live server container as the run output.

mcp_endpoint.title: MCP server endpoint
mcp_endpoint.description: Streamable-HTTP MCP endpoint of this run's Standby container (append /mcp, Bearer Apify token required).

run_output.title: Run details
run_output.description: Console view of this run (MCP servers return results inline over the protocol, not via dataset).
